# Sleep Foundation

> > Sleep Foundation provides expert-tested mattress reviews, buying guides, and sleep health education to help consumers find the best sleep solutions for their needs.

Sleep Foundation is a comprehensive resource for sleep wellness, featuring hands-on testing of 2,000+ mattresses across multiple categories and sleep positions. The site combines expert recommendations with consumer reviews to guide purchasing decisions for mattresses, pillows, and sleep-related products.

## Key Topics

- Mattress reviews
- Expert-tested
- Memory foam
- Pressure relief
- Back pain relief
- Side sleeper mattress
- Spinal alignment
- Cooling mattress
- Organic mattresses
- Hybrid mattresses
- Latex mattresses
- Innerspring mattresses
- Budget mattresses
- Sleep health
- Mattress buying guide

## Mattress Buying Guides

- [Best Mattress of 2026: Expert Tested and Sleeper Reviewed](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress): Comprehensive mattress buying guide with 2,000+ tested mattresses and expert recommendations.
- [Best Mattress for Side Sleepers in 2026: Expert Tested](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-mattress-for-side-sleepers): Expert guide to mattresses for side sleepers with pressure relief and spinal alignment.
- [Best Mattress for Back Pain in 2026: Expert Tested](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-mattress-for-back-pain): Guide to mattresses providing optimal spinal support and relief for back pain sufferers.
- [Best Affordable Mattresses of 2026: Expert-Tested Beds](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-cheap-mattress): Budget-friendly mattress guide balancing cost and quality under $1,000.

## Mattress Type Reviews

- [Best Memory Foam Mattress of 2026, Hand-Picked by Experts](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-memory-foam-mattress): Expert-tested memory foam mattress guide with pressure relief and motion isolation features.
- [Best Latex Mattresses of 2026: Tested and Picked by Experts](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-latex-mattress): Guide to 32 tested latex mattresses with cooling properties and eco-friendly options.
- [Best Innerspring Mattresses of 2026: Coil and Spring Support](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-innerspring-mattress): Expert guide to innerspring and hybrid mattresses with coil spring support systems.
- [Best Organic Mattress of 2026: Expert Tested and Approved](https://www.sleepfoundation.org/best-mattress/best-organic-mattresses): Guide to eco-friendly organic mattresses with third-party certifications and expert testing.
